description:
COSTS MONEY: Order a service

Orders a service from `list_services`, pays it gross (net plus VAT) from your balance and opens a support ticket with your answers, where the work is discussed. Set `variantKey` when it has variants and fill every required field. 402 with `details.balanceEur` and `details.grossEur` when the balance is short, 400 with `details.reason` (and `details.field`) when something is missing or invalid, 404 when not offered, 429 after 10 an hour.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.

answers.description: Field `key` to value: text up to 200 characters, long text up to 4000, country as ISO code, date and time as ISO 8601.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: order_service
title: Order a service
